}}'''Chilares Arman''' is a [[Murandy|Murandian]] [[Kin]] and a member of the [[Knitting Circle]] based in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Chilares Arman}}

== Appearance ==
She is willowy with doe-eyes and touches of gray in her hair. She appeared to be in her middle years.

== History and Abilities ==
Born in {{ne|657}}, she went to the White Tower in {{ne|672}}. She spent twelve years as a novice.

Her Saidar level of strength is {{opsl|43}}, which is enough to be tested for Aes Sedai (a medium-low level in Aes Sedai hierarchy). This level of strength is not enough to open a suitable [[Gateway]] for the [[Traveling]].

However Chilares refused to complete her test for [[Accepted]] and was forced to leave the White Tower. She then joined the [[Kin]].

== Activities ==

Chilares [[Traveling|Traveled]] with the the rest of the Kin group led by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Elayne Trakand]] from Ebou Dar to the Kin's [[farm]] with the [[Bowl of the Winds]].

She along with the rest of the group traveled to [[Caemlyn]] and resided there under the protection of Elayne and the leadership of Alise and Sumeko.
